Manufacturer max speed 250 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 22.5 mm3/s (printer profile 7.5) from the manufacturer's 250 mm/s rating.
Temperature set for ~250 mm/s on this printer: 220 C (first layer 200 C). Manufacturer bands: 190-215 C at 50-150 mm/s; 215-230 C at 150-250 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Four-colour silk gradient, full colour cycle about every 10 m (Rainbow 02 / 03 / 05 / Macaron). No settings in any listing text. yoopai.com 250g Silk Rainbow bundle page carries the lineup comparison chart, PLA Silk Rainbow row: 190-230C, <250 mm/s, 55C 8h (recorded). The Amazon 1kg listing (B0GT58FRB7) gallery has a parameter image: 190-215C @50-150 mm/s, 215-230C @150-250 mm/s (recorded as speed_temp_bands; consistent with the chart). Bed temperature not published anywhere. Sold as 1kg spools and 4 x 250g / 8 x 250g bundles. Spool shows the Ingeo logo; +/-0.03 mm.
